props.name: value
props.description: The chosen row's value. Controlled — leave it out and the column holds its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The row it starts on. Unset, and with no `value`, that is the first one.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired when the wheel comes to **rest** on a new row, never while it is turning: a column that reported every row it passed would fire nine times on one flick, and each of those is a value some caller would have written to a form.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Dims this column and stops its scroll.

props.name: value
props.description: What this row stands for. The column reports it; it is not the text.

props.name: size
props.description: The padding, the gaps and the corner. Never a height — a widget is as tall as its content.

props.name: radius
props.description: The frame's corner. The card's follows it, one step in.

props.name: isElevated
props.description: Whether the card is lifted off the frame.  On by default: the soft frame stays flat against the page and the shadow is what separates the card from it. There is no variant — a widget has one look.
